# Cookie debugging — diagnose cookies, auth, tracking and consent with Chrome DevTools MCP

Curated by Skill Harbor — @chromedevtools's cookie-debugging skill: a diagnostic playbook for cookies, authentication, tracking and consent, run through the Chrome DevTools MCP. Inspect cookie attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Partitioned/CHIPS), debug why logins fail, diagnose third-party cookie breakage after Chrome's deprecation, fix consent-banner interactions, and trace cross-site authentication flows — with a testing checklist for cookie-related regressions. Honest caveats: requires the Chrome DevTools MCP server configured in your agent environment — without it the agent can't execute the diagnostics; this is a debugging guide, not a privacy tool. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
